items.rationale: The fixed unit suffered covered lightning overvoltage under 2.3.3 and was nine metres from the hob, outside the five-metre exclusion in 2.3.10(c). Under 7.1.9–7.1.10, the 7.1 kW upgrade is payable only up to the cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW unit, estimated at €1,411 gross.

Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.10 cover ordinary installation labour at the pre-loss specification. The €482 gross estimate excludes any extra work required by the higher-output model or decorative console.
Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the whole console because it was chosen for appearance and was not needed to install the replacement.
Sections 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage attributable to the equivalent replacement. The estimated base freight is €42 gross, excluding the separately billed express surcharge.
Section 7.1.12 excludes the separate express and timed delivery surcharge; neither advance insurer approval nor a need to prevent further loss is stated.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed contractor administration and paperwork charges in full.
